usageNotes: Adds a single IP address, CIDR block, or alias to an existing cluster-level IPSet; the IPSet must already exist (create it first with POST /cluster/firewall/ipset). Requires the Sys.Modify privilege on '/'. Set nomatch=true to invert the entry, causing firewall rules that reference this IPSet to treat matching traffic as NOT belonging to the set.

examples.summary: Add a private subnet to the 'trusted-mgmt' IPSet with a descriptive comment

tips: The 'cidr' field accepts plain IPs (e.g. 192.168.1.5), CIDR ranges (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8), or an IPSet alias prefixed with '+' (e.g. +dc-hosts) if the alias is already defined.
nomatch entries are displayed with '!' in the Proxmox UI and flip the match logic for that entry — useful for blacklisting a subnet inside a broader allowed range.
This endpoint returns null on success; verify the entry was added with GET /cluster/firewall/ipset/{name}.
IPSet names must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores (2–64 chars); validate before calling.
